subject: Permission needed: Grade 3 Science Museum field trip (Fri Sep 25)
body:
Dear families,

Our Grade 3 classes, including Maya's group, will visit the Riverside Science Museum on Friday, September 25, 2026. The bus leaves school at 9:00 AM and returns by 2:30 PM.

Please return the attached permission form by Friday, September 18. A short reply to this email confirming Maya will attend is also appreciated.

Thank you,
Donna Avery
Maple Grove Elementary Office
